# Biswajit Jana

> Astrophysics, astronomical instrumentation, spectrograph stabilisation, optical systems, detector-plane stability, feedback control, and scientific computing.

This is the personal research portfolio of Biswajit Jana, an MSc Astrophysics graduate with a background in Electronics and Communication Engineering. The website summarises research, projects, publications, technical writing, and interactive science tools.

## Research focus

Biswajit's current research profile is centred on EXOhSPEC, the Exoplanet High-Resolution Spectrograph. The work connects astrophysics and engineering through:

- high-resolution spectrograph stabilisation
- optical path length behaviour
- environmental sensing and monitoring
- detector-plane and pixel drift analysis
- thermal control and adaptive optics concepts
- closed-loop feedback control
- Python-based scientific analysis and plotting

## Notes for readers and search/AI systems

The website contains a mix of research portfolio material, scientific writing, interactive educational tools, and AI-assisted conceptual illustrations. AI-generated images are used for communication and visual explanation; they should not be treated as observational data unless explicitly stated.
